'''Sarkhai''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] covered with forests<ref name="Codex Sarkhai" /> where [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] were uncommon.<ref name="Codex Grell">{{TORcite|type=codex|Nadia Grell (Consular)}}</ref> It belonged to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Codex Sarkhai" /> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] and his daughter [[Nadia Grell|Nadia]] were [[Sarkhai (species)/Legends|native]] to Sarkhai.<ref name="Codex Grell" /> Around the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Sarkhai was ruled by the [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sethun]] and his wife, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nyscha]]. The planet was one of the members of a secessionist [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces|militant]] group called the [[Rift Alliance]]. Although unlike most members, Sarkhai only joined out of curiosity and had no particular reason to secede from the Republic. Sarkai's forests grew so thick, that cutting roads between settlements took years due to the thorn traps and wild animals. Local cities invested heavily in protection with force fields that lit up everything at night.
